description: This is a unit test class for the DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl, testing different scenarios such as concurrent creation attempts and connection failures.

classes.name: DownstreamSenderFactoryImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl, verifying behavior under concurrent creation and connection failure scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializer for the test fixture, setting up mocks and the factory instance.

methods.name: testGetTelemetrySenderFailsIfInvokedConcurrently
methods.description: Tests that concurrent attempts to create a telemetry sender for the same tenant result in failure of the second attempt.

methods.description: Verifies that a failure in the underlying connection causes subsequent sender creation attempts to fail immediately.
